one_line: Mughal emperor Shah Jahan and his beloved consort Mumtaz Mahal during the creation of the Taj Mahal in 17th-century Agra.

appearance.age_look: Shah Jahan appears in his early 40s with a refined, athletic build; Mumtaz in her early 30s with a graceful, slender build.
appearance.face: Shah Jahan has an oval face, light brown complexion, neatly trimmed pointed beard and moustache, sharp nose, arched brows and calm, contemplative eyes with a gentle, dignified default expression; Mumtaz has a soft heart-shaped face, warm light-brown complexion, large expressive eyes, fine arched brows and a serene, affectionate default expression, with a tiny beauty mark near one cheek.
appearance.hair: Shah Jahan’s hair is black, tied in a small knot beneath a tall white turban wrapped with fine gold-striped cloth and a pale green sarpech plume ornament at the front; Mumtaz’s long black hair is parted in the middle, gathered in a low bun hidden under a translucent light-cream dupatta edged with fine gold embroidery, draped over her head and shoulders.
appearance.costume: Shah Jahan wears a long, fitted cream-coloured jama (overlapping wrap coat) of fine silk lightly patterned with pale gold floral motifs, tied at the side with a narrow maroon sash; beneath, a hint of a white cotton under-tunic and slim cream churidar trousers bunching neatly at the ankles; over his shoulders rests a soft pale-green silk shawl with subtle gold borders; he wears a multi-strand pearl necklace with one central emerald drop, a simple gold ring, and soft tan leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; Mumtaz wears an elegant, full-length Mughal angarkha-style gown in soft pastel peach silk with an overlapping front tied with delicate gold cords, its surface dotted with tiny stylised floral butis in pale green and white; beneath, she has a flowing light-cream peshwaz-style skirt that moves around her ankles and fitted churidar trousers; her light-cream dupatta with intricate gold edging and tiny floral motifs is draped over her head and across her chest; she wears delicate pearl earrings, a thin pearl and emerald necklace, a simple gold nath (nose ring without chain), slim gold bangles on both wrists and soft cream mojari shoes.
appearance.signature: Shah Jahan holds an unrolled pale-blue architectural drawing scroll of the Taj Mahal’s elevation in one hand, while Mumtaz gently touches the edge of the same scroll, linking them to the monument’s design.

ref_desc: Shah Jahan is a light-brown, oval-faced Mughal emperor in a cream, gold-floral jama with maroon sash, pale-green shawl and white turban with green plume holding a pale-blue Taj Mahal plan scroll beside Mumtaz Mahal, a light-brown, heart-faced woman in pastel-peach angarkha, cream dupatta and pearl jewellery sharing the same scroll, all in cream, pale gold, pastel peach, pale green and maroon tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Shah Jahan and Mumtaz Mahal together in 17th-century Mughal Agra, designed to be redrawn consistently: Shah Jahan appears early-40s with a light-brown oval face, neatly trimmed pointed beard and moustache, sharp nose and calm, contemplative eyes, wearing a long fitted cream silk jama patterned with pale gold floral motifs, tied at the side with a narrow maroon sash, over slim cream churidar trousers and tan leather mojari shoes; a soft pale-green silk shawl with subtle gold borders drapes over his shoulders, and he wears a multi-strand pearl necklace with one central emerald drop, a simple gold ring and a tall white turban wrapped in fine gold-striped cloth, adorned at the front with a pale-green plume sarpech ornament; he holds an unrolled pale-blue architectural drawing scroll of the Taj Mahal’s elevation in his right hand. Beside him, Mumtaz Mahal appears early-30s with a warm light-brown heart-shaped face, large expressive eyes, fine arched brows, a tiny beauty mark near one cheek and a serene, affectionate expression; her long black hair is parted and gathered in a low bun hidden beneath a translucent light-cream dupatta edged with fine gold embroidery and tiny floral motifs, draped over her head and flowing across her chest. She wears a full-length pastel-peach silk angarkha-style gown with overlapping front tied by delicate gold cords, its surface dotted with tiny stylised floral butis in pale green and white, over a light-cream peshwaz-style skirt and fitted churidar trousers, with soft cream mojari shoes just visible; she is adorned with delicate pearl earrings, a thin pearl-and-emerald necklace, a simple gold nose ring and slim gold bangles on both wrists. Her left hand gently touches the edge of the same pale-blue scroll Shah Jahan is holding, visually linking them to the Taj Mahal’s creation; emphasise dignified, heroic, historically grounded Mughal costumes, clean shonen-anime energy, and a harmonious palette of cream, pale gold, pastel peach, pale green and maroon against a very soft, unfocused hint of the Yamuna riverfront and distant white marble domes.
